0239851c99f1.name: War Engine
0239851c99f1.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back. When it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move over other models (except TITANIC models) as if they weren't there, and may pass within Engagement Range of them, but it can't end that move within Engagement Range of any of them.

05baaf678b75.name: Warhound plasma blastgun
05baaf678b75.plain: Before you pick targets, choose which one of the profiles below this weapon will attack with.

0c9217a63aa5.name: Apocalypse missile launcher
0c9217a63aa5.plain: You can shoot this weapon at units the bearer can't see.

11c1261b724f.name: Anvillus defence battery
11c1261b724f.plain: Attacks with this weapon can only be aimed at units that can FLY.

24964a27805a.name: Reactor Meltdown
24964a27805a.plain: Before you remove this model after it is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 6+, it explodes, and each unit within 3D6" of it suffers 2D6 mortal wounds.

2cc18cbd9639.name: Void Shields
2cc18cbd9639.plain:
This model has 6 void shields, each with 3 shield points. As long as it still has at least one void shield, it gets a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

When a saving throw for this model against a ranged attack fails and it still has a void shield, it takes no damage. Instead, each point of damage removes 1 shield point from one of its void shields. Once a void shield has started losing shield points, all further damage must keep going to that shield until it collapses. When an attack brings a void shield down to 0 shield points, the shield collapses: this model loses it, and any damage left over from that attack is lost. Void shields never stop mortal wounds: each mortal wound inflicted on this model makes it lose 1 wound in the normal way.

At the start of your Command phase, any void shield on this model with fewer than 3 shield points left goes back up to 3 shield points.

3dced6d1872c.name: Void Shields
3dced6d1872c.plain:
This model has 8 void shields of 3 shield points each, and a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks while any of them remain.

Each time this model fails a saving throw against a ranged attack while it has a void shield, it takes no damage. Instead, for each point of damage, one void shield loses 1 shield point. After a void shield has lost any shield points, all further damage goes to that shield until it collapses. When an attack brings a void shield down to 0 shield points, it collapses: this model loses that shield, and any damage left over from that attack is lost. Void shields never stop mortal wounds: each mortal wound makes this model lose one wound as normal.

When your Command phase starts, any void shield with fewer than 3 shield points left goes back up to 3.

3e6b56529a00.name: Battle Titan
3e6b56529a00.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. When it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move through other models as if they weren't there, except MONSTER and VEHICLE models. While doing this it can pass within Engagement Range of those models, but it can't end its move within Engagement Range of any of them.

6b246ed0623d.name: Void Shields
6b246ed0623d.plain:
This model has 4 void shields, each with 3 shield points. As long as it still has at least one void shield, it gets a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

When a saving throw for this model against a ranged attack fails and it still has a void shield, it takes no damage. Instead, each point of damage removes 1 shield point from one of its void shields. Once a void shield has started losing shield points, all further damage must keep going to that shield until it collapses. When an attack brings a void shield down to 0 shield points, the shield collapses: this model loses it, and any damage left over from that attack is lost. Void shields never stop mortal wounds: each mortal wound inflicted on this model makes it lose 1 wound in the normal way.

At the start of your Command phase, any void shield on this model with fewer than 3 shield points left goes back up to 3 shield points.

72dcee621624.name: Reactor Meltdown
72dcee621624.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before taking it off the battlefield: on a 6+, it explodes and every unit within 4D6" takes 3D6 mortal wounds.

75ed33929231.name: Reaver melta cannon
75ed33929231.plain: Blast. Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a target unit within half range, the attack's Damage characteristic is 12.

7bf10e306400.name: Reaver power fist
7bf10e306400.plain: Each time an attack made with this weapon destroys a VEHICLE or MONSTER model, you can choose an enemy unit within 9": roll one D6, and on a 4+ the chosen unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

a5ec6a644da1.name: Reaver feet
a5ec6a644da1.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, roll 2 hit rolls for it rather than 1.

c213b7c58f56.name: Flank Speed
c213b7c58f56.plain: Each time this model Advances, don't make an Advance roll. Instead, add 12" to its Move characteristic until the end of the Movement phase.

ee8b50c7437f.name: Ardex-defensor maulers
ee8b50c7437f.plain: When this weapon profile is used to fire Overwatch, each of its attacks hits on a roll of 5 or 6.
